- Initial release of b2b-factory-search as a SKILL for efficiently finding qualified manufacturers for business buyers.
- Converts spoken sourcing needs into a structured factory shortlist with links, business info, and capability tags.
- Supports screening by main product, production methods, region, qualifications, and factory type.
- Outputs results in text, Markdown, or HTML, preserving only verified information from business records.
- Strict boundaries: does not rate factory reliability, make recommendations, or fabricate data; provides only public profile info.
- All outreach actions (inquiries/orders) are left for the user to do via factory profile links.
